追.mn: The road radical ⻌ underneath means going, and 𠂤 on top is a heap of piled earth — you run along the road past the mound, chasing after someone.

w.t: The police are chasing the suspect.

w.s: 書類を一枚追加します。
w.t: I will add one more document.

w.s: 子供が犬を追いかける。
w.t: The child runs after the dog.

w.s: 前の電車に追いつきました。
w.t: We caught up with the earlier train.
A car rear-ended another one.

商.mn: A 立 stands on top of a wide 冂 enclosure with 口 tucked inside it: the merchant stands at his stall and calls prices out of the little window.

w.t: This product is popular.

w.s: 父は商売をしています。
w.t: My father runs a business.

w.s: 駅前の商店で買います。
w.t: I buy it at the shop by the station.

w.s: この町は商業が盛んだ。
w.t: Commerce thrives in this town.
I work for a trading company.

葉.mn: Grass 艹 sits on 枼, which is 世 (generation) over 木 (tree): the tree puts out a fresh crop of leaves generation after generation.

w.t: The leaves have turned yellow.
I said something kind to them.

w.s: 市役所から葉書が来た。
w.t: A postcard came from city hall.
I gather the fallen leaves in the yard.

w.s: 山の紅葉がきれいです。
w.t: The autumn colors on the mountain are lovely.

形.mn: On the left 开 is a frame standing on 干, a flat base; the three strokes 彡 on the right are the shading a painter adds so the frame reads as a shape.

w.t: This leaf has a strange shape.
I bought my daughter a doll.
Follow the format for the application.
The plaza is circular.

w.s: 新しい町が形成された。
w.t: A new town was formed.

落.mn: Grass 艹 over 洛, which is water 氵 beside 各 (夂 over 口): rain runs off the leaves and everything comes down.

w.t: My wallet fell on the floor.
I dropped my key on the train.

w.s: 少し落ち着いて話そう。
w.t: Let's calm down and talk.
I turned in a lost item at the station.

w.s: その候補者は落選した。
w.t: That candidate lost the election.

頭.mn: 豆, a bean-shaped offering stand, on the left; 頁 on the right is the old picture of a head — 目 (eyes) with 八 (legs) beneath the face.

w.t: My head hurts a little.
I have had a headache since morning.
I stood at the front of the line.
You can apply at the store counter.
I explained it verbally.

毎.mn: The hairpin stroke 𠂉 sits on 毋, the old form of mother: mother puts her pin in and does the same round of chores every single day.

w.t: I commute by train every day.
I study Japanese every week.
I get up at six every morning.
I pay the rent every month.
I go back to my country every year.

医.mn: An arrow 矢 (itself 天 over 大 in shape) shut inside the box 匸: the old doctor's job was pulling arrows out and locking them away.

w.t: I consulted a doctor.
Medical costs are high.
My daughter studies medicine.
I go to the neighborhood clinic.

w.s: 明日歯医者に行きます。
w.t: I am going to the dentist tomorrow.

仕.mn: A person 亻 standing beside 士, the scholar-official: the person who attends on the official, and by extension the work he does.

w.t: There is a lot of work today.
I ask how to apply.
I will finish the documents today.
I am learning how elections work.
He served the president for a long time.

去.mn: Earth 土 above and 厶 below: a person turns away from the ground he stood on and goes off, so the place becomes the past.

w.t: He left the town.
I came to Japan last year.
I check the past records.
I give notice that I am moving out.
I reported my grandfather's death.

味.mn: The mouth 口 next to 未, a tree 木 with an extra short branch on top meaning not-yet: the mouth testing fruit that is not yet ripe.

w.t: I like this flavor.
What does this word mean?
My hobby is photography.
I will always be on your side.
I taste the soup.

負.mn: A person bending forward 𠂊 over 貝, a shell of money (目 with 八 legs): you carry the load on your back, and if you cannot, you lose.

w.t: We lost the match.
I will take responsibility.
The share of medical costs is heavy.
Let's fight it out to the end.
He was injured in the accident.

門.mn: Two tall doors facing each other, each with its hinge post and panel. Draw the left leaf first, then the right; nothing else goes inside.

w.t: The school gate closes.
My specialty is law.
I am waiting at the main gate.

w.s: 日本語入門の本を読む。
w.t: I read an introductory Japanese book.
I work in the sales division.

写.mn: A cover 冖 over 与 (to give): what is under the cover is handed over again exactly as it was, so it is a copy.

w.t: You need a photo for the application.
I copy the words from the board.
It came out well in the picture.
I photocopied the documents.
I sketch from life in the park.

守.mn: A roof 宀 with 寸, a hand measuring, underneath: one hand kept under the roof of the house, guarding it.

w.t: I will keep my promise.
I will be out during the day.
The child stays home alone.
I quietly watch over the children.
I gave my name to the guard.

美.mn: ⺷, a sheep seen from the front, sitting on 大, a big person with arms out: a big fat sheep was the picture of something fine, hence beautiful.

w.t: The harbor at night is beautiful.
I borrowed a book on art.
My mother was beautiful in her youth.
I go to the salon on Saturday.

w.s: この店の魚は美味しい。
w.t: The fish at this shop is delicious.

命.mn: 人 with 一 makes the roof of an order coming down; 口 is the mouth that gives it and 卩 is the person kneeling to receive it — the order handed to you is your life.

w.t: I treasure life.
I took out life insurance.
I follow my boss's orders.
This too is fate.
Japan has a long life expectancy.

福.mn: The altar radical 礻 on the left, and on the right 畐 — 一 and 口 over 田 — a jar filled to the brim. A full jar set on the altar brings blessings.

w.t: I live happily with my family.
I consult the city welfare office.
We blessed the couple.
I buy a lucky bag at New Year.
The company benefits are good.

整.mn: On top a bundle 束 with a hand and stick 攵 tapping it; below, 正 standing straight. You knock the bundle level until everything is correct.

w.t: I will sort the documents.
I tidy my clothes before going.

w.s: 日程を調整しましょう。
w.t: Let's adjust the schedule.
I put the car in for servicing.

w.s: 入口で整列してください。
w.t: Please line up at the entrance.

横.mn: Wood 木 on the left and 黄 (yellow) on the right, itself 龷 over 由 over 八: a yellowed beam of timber laid across sideways.

w.t: There is a police box next to the station.
I cross at the crosswalk.
Crossing here is dangerous.
A cat cut across the road.
I looked at my father's profile.

白.mn: The sun 日 with one short stroke added on top: the first white flash of light above the rising sun.

w.t: I wear a white shirt.
I choose white and black.
This book is interesting.
Write your name in the blank.
He confessed honestly.

深.mn: Water 氵 beside a cave mouth 冖 with 儿 legs below it and 木 at the bottom: you reach down through the hole to touch the wood at the bottom, so the water is deep.

w.t: This river is deep.
I measure the depth of the pond.
I worked until late at night.
The problem has become serious.

w.s: 面接の前に深呼吸する。
w.t: I take a deep breath before the interview.

字.mn: A child 子 under the roof 宀 of the house: the child sits indoors learning to write characters.

w.t: I write the characters neatly.
I practice kanji every day.
The letters are too small.

w.s: 名字を書いてください。
w.t: Please write your surname.
I checked the figures.

答.mn: Bamboo 竹 over 合 (人, 一 and 口 fitting together): the reply written on a bamboo slip that fits the question exactly.

w.t: I will answer the question.
I do not know the answer.
A reply came from the city.
I will reply right away.
I check it against the answer key.

夜.mn: A lid 亠 for the sky, a person 亻 tucked under it, and 夕, the evening moon, on the right: a person standing out under the night sky.

w.t: It gets quiet at night.
They say it will rain tonight.
I woke up in the middle of the night.
I am on the night shift this week.
I take the late-night bus.

音.mn: The same 立 top as 言, but the mouth below is sealed shut into 日 with a bar across it: nothing articulate comes out, only sound.

w.t: There was a loud noise outside.
I listen to music on the train.
My pronunciation was corrected.
The construction noise is terrible.

w.s: 上の階の足音が聞こえる。
w.t: I can hear footsteps upstairs.

申.mn: A box 日 with one line 丨 driven straight through top to bottom: the message goes right through, spoken up plainly to those above.

w.t: My name is Tanaka.
I applied for naturalization.
I apply at the counter.
I filed my tax return.
I stamp my seal on the application form.

様.mn: Wood 木 on the left; on the right a sheep 羊 with its 䒑 horns above flowing water 氺: a pattern in the grain, and so a way or manner.

w.t: I will see how things look outside.
Is everyone well?
A customer has arrived.
I pay the same as last year.
There are people from various countries.

港.mn: Water 氵 beside 巷, which is 共 (together, 八 under the top bars) over 己: the place by the water where everyone comes together.

w.t: A ship came into the harbor.
I go to the airport by train.
Kobe is a port town.
The ship departs in the morning.
I buy fish at the fishing port.

注.mn: Water 氵 next to 主, a lamp stand 王 with the flame 丶 on top: water poured steadily like oil kept in a burning lamp.

w.s: 足元に注意してください。
w.t: Please watch your step.
I placed an order at the shop.
I pour water into the glass.
This proposal drew attention.
I got an injection at the hospital.

帰.mn: On the right a broom 帚 — the hand ⺕ over 冖 over the cloth 巾 — held beside the short left post: you come back home and take up the broom.

w.t: I go home at six.
I shop on the way home.
I want to naturalize as a Japanese citizen.
I return to my country next month.
I get home at eight every day.

谷.mn: A mouth 口 at the bottom with two pairs of strokes splaying open above it: the slopes part and the valley opens its mouth.

w.t: A river runs through the valley.
I can see a house in the ravine.
I walk the gorge in autumn.
We climbed down to the valley floor.
The canyon scenery is fine.

古.mn: Ten 十 over a mouth 口: a story that has passed through ten mouths is an old one.

w.t: This house is old.
I bought a used car.
I take old clothes to the shop.
I study ancient history.
I buy used books by the station.

天.mn: A big person 大 with one long line 一 drawn above his head: what is over everybody, the sky.

w.t: The weather is good today.

w.s: 天皇は日本の象徴です。
w.t: The Emperor is the symbol of Japan.
This place is a paradise for children.
The ceiling light burned out.
That child is a genius.

階.mn: The hill 阝 on the left is a bank cut into steps; 皆 on the right is 比 (people side by side) over 白 — everyone climbing the steps together, one floor at a time.

w.t: I take the stairs to the second floor.
This shop is on the third floor.
There is a room on the second floor.
We are at the final stage now.
I study social classes.

歌.mn: 哥 on the left is 可 stacked twice, the same phrase called out again and again; 欠 on the right is a person with the mouth wide open.

w.t: I listen to a song I like.
We all sang together.
A famous singer came.
We sing the national anthem at the ceremony.
We sing the school song at graduation.

買.mn: A net 罒 laid over a shell of money 貝 (目 with 八 legs): you take your money out and net the goods with it.

w.t: I buy a ticket at the station.
I go shopping in the evening.
I report the sale of the land.

w.s: 家の買い手が決まった。
w.t: A buyer for the house was found.
The company was bought out.

光.mn: ⺌ on top is a small fire held up, 兀 below is 一 over 儿, a person's legs: someone kneeling with a torch raised over their head.

w.t: Light comes in through the window.
The stars shine in the sky.
I went sightseeing in Kyoto.
Sunlight comes into the room.
It is an unforgettable scene.

路.mn: The foot 足 on the left and 各 on the right, itself a foot 夂 coming down onto 口: each foot that sets out takes the road.

w.t: The road is congested.
Do not step onto the tracks.
Do not leave bags in the aisle.

w.s: このバス路線は便利だ。
w.t: This bus route is convenient.

w.s: 路上の駐車は禁止です。
w.t: Parking on the street is prohibited.

悪.mn: 亜 on top is a squared foundation dug into the ground, 二 and 一 boxing in a 口; the heart 心 is pinned underneath it. A heart crushed flat turns bad.

w.t: The weather is bad.
Do not speak ill of people.
I consider the worst case.
The illness got worse.
He is not a bad man.
